purpose: Centralize campaign review into one predictable Markdown surface and one portable provenance-preserving ZIP.
executive_summary: Codex added an explicit-source review-handoff generator, stable CURRENT_REVIEW files, provenance and omission manifests, sensitive-file and size safeguards, deterministic ZIP output, history copies, and bundle-only review verification. It demonstrates the workflow by consuming the existing Validation Evidence Standard packets without changing their canonical evidence.

validation: No validator, evaluator authority, semantic gate, threshold, or calibration case changed.
Consumed standardized behavioral evidence without rewriting it.
tooling: Added config-driven CURRENT_REVIEW.md, REVIEW_MANIFEST.json, and CURRENT_REVIEW.zip generation.
Added provenance hashes, deduplication, explicit omission reasons, size warnings, sensitive-path safeguards, deterministic ZIP construction, and optional handoff history.
documentation: Added the permanent Review Handoff Standard and pre-implementation handoff inventory.
generated_artifacts: Generated the stable current review summary, manifest, ZIP, and campaign history copy.

testing.broader: 70 review-handoff/evidence/reactive/calibration/playability tests passed; one existing Starlette TestClient deprecation warning.
testing.full_suite: 49 failures, matching the known pre-existing red baseline count and unrelated failure families.
testing.runtime_validation: No gameplay rerun was performed. The campaign consumed preserved runtime evidence.
testing.model_runtime_boundary: Packaged behavioral evidence came from prior in-process POST /api/chat runs using the configured live AI-GM runtime.
testing.new_regressions: No campaign-specific regression was found in focused or broader verification.
testing.pre_existing_failures: Attribution, BW/BZ closeout, replay/projection, ownership/import governance, final-emission, social-lead, scene-fallback, and validation-layer separation failures remain.

decisions_requiring_human_review: Decide in a later calibration campaign whether the concise refusal 'Not something I can say here.' should become an accepted calibration boundary.
Decide in a later calibration campaign whether visible-notice clarification redirected through NPC ignorance should become a negative calibration case.
Keep the grammatically degraded notice response ambiguous unless further evidence supports a stable policy.

campaign_specific: The evidence packet exposes one probable evaluator miss, one probable false positive, and one ambiguous generated response. They were preserved, not repaired.
pre_existing: The repository full suite remains red with 49 failures in previously known unrelated families.

missing_concepts: Player-to-GM communication versus character speech/action authority.
does_not_prove: Broad gameplay quality or that the AI-GM generally works.
Rendered UI usability or browser gameplay.
Long-session coherence, hidden-state consistency, or broad human realism.
That human review has resolved either evaluator disagreement.
recommended_next_step: Conduct a separate human-reviewed calibration campaign for the two preserved evaluator disagreements. Do not begin gameplay repair before that decision.

supporting_files.why: Documents existing campaign output conventions and the canonical/generated boundary.
Defines the behavioral evidence contract consumed by the handoff demonstration.
Documents existing evidence producers and their actual guarantees.
Explains the source reactive campaign architecture, findings, and limits.
Preserves human classifications behind evaluator disagreements and ambiguity.
Defines the shared evidence-packet contract and deterministic selection behavior.
Shows canonical evidence adapters and generation workflow.
Implements review selection, safeguards, summary rendering, manifest provenance, and ZIP generation.
Defines the review-handoff safety, provenance, determinism, and self-contained-review contract.

self_contained_review_test: PASS: using only an extracted CURRENT_REVIEW.zip, the focused test answered campaign, change, non-change, tests, baseline, exact player/GM evidence, disagreements, ambiguity, decisions, limits, provenance, and next-step questions.
